summary: Full e2e testing of GBPIET Result Asterisk Portal: 14/14 backend pytest tests passed, all critical frontend flows working. The reported admin login form-submission issue could NOT be reproduced — login fires /api/auth/login, navigates to /admin overview, displays stats and uploads correctly. End-to-end student portal flow (login -> /student/results) verified with sample roll 230090107001 (Civil Eng, V Sem) showing semester results correctly.

minor.issue: stats reports backlogs_total=0 even when SEM excel detects 20 back students. This means apply_back_markers (matching back subjects from Excel into TC/GS records) is not actually flagging subject.back=true when persisted. Possible root cause: roll numbers in AIML excel SEM_I don't align with roll numbers in tc.pdf (TC is AIML batch presumably 2025 starting roll 250090170*** while Excel is for 2022 AIML batch with rolls 220090170***). UI shows '20 BACKS (EXCEL)' from upload count but '0 BACK SUBJECTS FLAGGED' in stats — confirms no record-level merge happened. Recommend: either (a) document that Excel must be the same batch as TC/GS, or (b) fall back to fuzzy/last-three-digit roll matching, or (c) surface a warning when 0/N rolls match between Excel and TC records.

integration_issues.issue: Two console 401 errors observed (likely /api/auth/me triggered by AuthProvider on every route including student portal). Harmless but noisy — consider skipping /auth/me when not on /admin route or suppressing console errors for expected 401.

action_items: Investigate why apply_back_markers is not flagging any backs into the persisted result records despite Excel back detection working (sample TC vs sample Excel may belong to different AIML batches — surface a warning when intersection of Excel rolls and TC rolls is empty).
Optional: skip /auth/me on non-admin routes to avoid spurious 401 errors in student portal.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLogin.jsx form submission verified working end-to-end — the suspected bug is NOT present. Form's onSubmit fires, login API is called, token stored in localStorage as 'admin_token', cookie set httpOnly+secure+samesite=none, and navigation to /admin succeeds.

AdminLayout.jsx correctly handles dual-auth state (cookie OR Bearer token via hasToken localStorage check) so even if cookie auth fails (cross-site cookies on preview domain), Bearer token still authorizes the user.
processor.apply_back_markers logic likely silently no-ops when sample TC and sample Excel belong to different batches; should log warning when 0 of N rolls intersect.
server.py does not split /admin endpoints by router; file size acceptable (<520 lines).
Mongo _id properly excluded from all responses ({"_id": 0} projections used consistently).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@gbpiet.ac.in / Admin@2026 (works). Student: roll 230090107001 with any DOB (works after gs.pdf is uploaded).
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures upload tc.pdf+aiml.xlsx (B.Tech AIML 2022 SEM_I) and gs.pdf (B.Tech Civil 2023 SEM_V) into the live DB. These are reusable seed data for subsequent runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_portal_api.py — 14 tests, runs in ~25s, hits real preview URL. The aiml.xlsx file has rolls for 2022 batch while tc.pdf has different (likely 2025) batch rolls; the back-marker join therefore yields 0 actual marked subjects in DB even though Excel reports backs. This is the most likely original confusion behind the 'admin login redirect issue' report — login itself is fine, but admin saw '0 back subjects flagged' on overview which may have looked wrong.
rca of the issue: Reported admin-login redirect bug NOT reproducible. The form has data-testid=admin-login-submit, onSubmit=submit handler calls login() from useAuth which POSTs /api/auth/login (verified via network capture), stores token in localStorage and navigates to /admin via react-router. Manual browser test in the original report likely failed due to (a) clicking the button before form mount, (b) a stale preview build before hot-reload, or (c) an aborted navigation when screenshot tool overlay covered the button. Latest preview build works flawlessly.
